title: Evaluation of the synergistic and antagonistic antibacterial effects of pulsed electromagnetic fields combined with ciprofloxacin and nanochitosan
task: Evaluate synergistic/antagonistic effects of pulsed electromagnetic fields on antibiotic-nanoparticle bacterial killing

comments: This counterintuitive negative result is valuable as a mechanistic cautionary tale, revealing how electromagnetic parameters can inadvertently strengthen bacterial defenses rather than enhance drug delivery.

model_io.model: Multi-factorial screening of ELF PEMW + ciprofloxacin-chitosan nanoparticles against gram-negative and gram-positive bacteria
inputs: bacterial strains (E. coli, P. aeruginosa, S. aureus)

hypotheses.hypothesis: ELF PEMW enhances antibiotic efficacy through increased membrane permeability
hypotheses.result: Rejected; ELF PEMW reduced efficacy via membrane hyperpolarization and nanoparticle aggregation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electromagnetic antagonism is universal across bacterial species
